skip_reason: The macOS Control Skill is fundamentally incompatible with an isolated Linux Docker container. It requires: (1) Multi-modal perception — the `vision_wrapper.sh` uses macOS-native `screencapture` to capture a live GUI desktop, which is explicitly banned; (2) macOS-specific host hardware access — `cliclick` at `/opt/homebrew/bin/cliclick` and macOS `screencapture` are macOS-only binaries unavailable on Linux; (3) A graphical desktop environment (GUI) for all meaningful interactions. The entire skill's value proposition is screen capture + synthetic mouse/keyboard input on a live macOS desktop, which cannot be replicated or meaningfully mocked in a text-only Docker container without defeating the purpose of testing the skill itself.
